package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"

	r "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/components/r"
	nested "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/pages/nested"
	term "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/pages/term"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/r"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/pages/nested"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/pages/term"
	"github.com/orbit-z/lyr"
)

func main() {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	for _, mode := range []string{"", "top", "for", "switch", "notfound", "redirect", "nil", "closure", "helper", "multi", "block", "two"} {
		buf.Reset()
		err := r.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), r.Props{Mode: mode}, lyr.Slots{})
		var re *lyr.RedirectError
		fmt.Printf("%s: %v %q notExist=%v unwrappedNotFound=%v unwrappedRedirect=%v\n", mode, err, buf.String(),
			errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist), err == lyr.ErrNotFound, errors.As(err, &re) && err == error(re))
	}
	buf.Reset()
	err := nested.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), nested.Props{}, lyr.Slots{})
	fmt.Printf("nested: %v\n", err)
	buf.Reset()
	err = term.Render(&lyr.Ctx{}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), term.Props{}, lyr.Slots{})
	fmt.Printf("term: %v %q\n", err, buf.String())
}
